slides.title: Capture every detail
slides.body: An advanced 3-camera system, from ultra-wide 0.6x to 70x ultra zoom, lets you capture distant details up close or take portrait-perfect shots with 3.5x optical zoom.

slides.title: Get closer with 70x ultra zoom
slides.body: Phone (4a) is the only phone in its segment featuring a 50 MP OIS periscope camera with up to 70x ultra zoom, designed to help you capture stunning detail at any distance.

slides.title: Tetraprism periscope zoom
slides.body: Phone (4a)’s periscope camera features an advanced tetraprism system that delivers 3.5x optical zoom with zero light loss, using a three-mirror, W-shaped light path to preserve image detail while reducing the camera bump by 32%*. *Compared to Phone (3a) Pro.

slides.title: Brighter shots with a big sensor
slides.body: A 50 MP OIS main camera with one of the segment’s largest sensors captures 64% more light*, delivering cleaner detail and clearer shots – especially at night. *Compared to other 1/1.95" camera sensors.

slides.title: No more selfie sticks
slides.body: The super-wide 32 MP front camera is designed to capture larger groups. A new 89° wide-angle lens offers 10% wider coverage than Phone (3a) Pro.

slides.title: True-to-life details
slides.body: Phone (4a) is powered by TrueLens Engine 4, advanced multi-frame RAW processing and 12-layer AI segmentation for Ultra XDR photos, Motion Photos, portraits and lifelike details.

slides.title: Ultra XDR photo
slides.body: Capture 13 RAW frames at varying exposures and merge them to reveal true-to-life detail, with every pixel’s brightness boosted up to 12 times on screen, ready to share on Instagram.

slides.title: Ultra XDR photo
slides.body: Capture 13 RAW frames at varying exposures and merge them to reveal true-to-life detail, with every pixel’s brightness boosted up to 12 times on screen, ready to share on Instagram.

slides.title: Ultra XDR photos that move
slides.body: Tap the shutter to capture up to 3 seconds of sound, colour and movement in a single photo. Plus, Phone (4a) captures around 90 frames for you to choose from.

slides.title: Create in 4K video
slides.body: Capture ultra-detailed 4K videos and Ultra XDR Full HD footage with exceptional quality in any lighting condition.

slides.title: Accurate colour
slides.body: AI analyses each scene across up to 12 pixel-level layers to optimise subject and background, delivering accurate colour and a natural balance between foreground and background.

slides.title: Accurate colour
slides.body: AI analyses each scene across up to 12 pixel-level layers to optimise subject and background, delivering accurate colour and a natural balance between foreground and background.

slides.title: Pro-level portraits
slides.body: AI subject segmentation identifies elements within a portrait, from clothing to skin and fine details like hair to create natural bokeh, accurate skin tones and stunning photos.

slides.title: Pro-level portraits
slides.body: AI subject segmentation identifies elements within a portrait, from clothing to skin and fine details like hair to create natural bokeh, accurate skin tones and stunning photos.

slides.title: Make every shot cinematic
slides.body: Fine-tune up to 7 camera settings like a pro, shoot in RAW for maximum editing control or apply ready-made presets created by Nothing Community photographers.

slides.title: No more bad photos
slides.body: New to the Nothing Gallery app, AI Eraser instantly removes unwanted objects, people, and reflections with a single tap*. It runs fully on-device, so your photos never leave your phone. *Circle to Erase coming soon.

slides.title: Are we live?
slides.body: Inspired by traditional film cameras, a custom red recording light flicks on when you’re shooting video on Phone (4a), so it’s always clear when recording is active.

slides.title: The brand-new Glyph Bar
slides.body: Put your screen down and reduce distractions. Understand what’s happening on your smartphone at a glance through the Glyph Bar with light patterns and sounds.

slides.title: Essential Notifications
slides.body: Signals only you understand. Assign discreet light patterns to specific contacts or keywords in Essential Notifications, so important notifications stand out – clearly for you, quietly for everyone else.

slides.title: Glyph Bar progress tracker
slides.body: Progress-based notifications now appear on the Glyph Bar, synced with your screen. Track rides, deliveries, and timers with intuitive lights and motion cues at a glance. Supported apps include Uber, Google Calendar, Zomato, Just Eat, and Google Maps, with more integrations coming soon¹².

slides.title: Light work
slides.body: Made with 63 precision mini-LEDs, Glyph Bar is up to 40% brighter*. *Compared to Phone (3a) Pro.

slides.title: Design evolution
slides.body: Built on transparency, Phone (4a) fuses human warmth with elite engineering. Aluminium details and organic curves sit beneath a glass back for an elevated feel.

slides.title: Make room for colour
slides.body: Phone (4a) comes in Black, White, and a new tinted glass finish, revealing striking Blue and Pink colourways that bring more personality and joy to everyday tech.

slides.title: Built to last
slides.body: Ready for life’s little surprises. Phone (4a) is rated IP64 for dust and water resistance and tested under 25 cm of water for up to 20 minutes. With new high-grade tempered glass on the front and back and more metal throughout, it delivers a 34% improvement* in bend resistance. *Compared to Phone (3a) Pro.

slides.title: Life runs easier on Nothing OS
slides.body: A calmer, personalised and intentional experience with smart tools to keep you focused. Built on Android 16 with 3 years of OS updates and 6 years of security updates.

slides.title: Unified simplicity
slides.body: Unified hardware and software design, unique to Nothing, across icons and layouts to improve clarity, speed and focus.

slides.title: Personal by design
slides.body: Customise your home and lock screens with widgets that matter, flexible layouts and new depth-effect wallpapers that adapt around your subject.

slides.title: Fast and smooth
slides.body: Animations feel smoother and more natural than ever when opening, closing or switching apps, and when scrolling through photos, reducing stutter and lag.

slides.title: Live updates with Glyph Bar
slides.body: Real time updates stay visible across the Always-on Display, Status Bar, Lock Screen and Notifications, so you can stay aware without opening apps. When your phone is on the table or nearby, progress shows through the Glyph Bar, making it easy to follow rides, deliveries or timers at a glance. Supports Uber, Google Calendar, Zomato, Just Eat and Google Maps. More integrations coming soon¹².

slides.title: Built-in Google Gemini
slides.body: Meet Gemini, your personal AI assistant from Google, designed to fuel your creativity and get things done. Whether it’s writing, planning or learning, Gemini is here to make your ideas come to life.

slides.title: ChatGPT integration
slides.body: Get answers, explore ideas and think things through across your Nothing devices. ChatGPT is integrated into Nothing OS and works through widgets, audio and watch interactions, so help is always close without pulling you out of what you’re doing.

slides.title: Nothing OS 4.1 highlights
slides.body: A redesigned lock screen with more clock and widget sizes. Two new Relax widgets help you unwind and stay focused. Plus, the system is now smoother and more responsive than ever.

slides.title: A more personal way to use your phone
slides.body: Essential is a set of AI tools and features within Nothing OS that help you capture, find, remember, and create with less effort. It adapts over time to the way you think and live.

slides.title: Essential Space
slides.body: Essential Space is your second memory. It's a place for you to capture and save what matters. Use the Essential Key to instantly capture an idea, screenshot, photo or voice note. Our powerful AI processing makes sense of it by creating intelligent summaries, extracting key information and to-dos, and even helping you remember upcoming events. You capture. Essential Space takes care of the rest. Essential Space syncs seamlessly across devices. Over time, your Essential Space will be available across your phone, laptop, desktop, and more, so what matters is always within reach.

slides.title: Essential Search
slides.body: Essential Search is Nothing’s own AI-powered search. Instead of giving you a list of links, it delivers concise, to-the-point answers without wasting your time. Look up news, recipes or get translations instantly. Integrated directly into Nothing OS, Essential Search works without opening any apps. Just swipe up on your home screen and start typing in the search bar.

slides.title: Essential Memory
slides.body: Essential Memory helps you recall important information naturally. Memories are created from what you capture in Essential Space, adding personal context to the answers you get from Essential Search.

slides.title: Essential Voice
slides.body: Essential Voice turns your speech into clear, well-structured text. It removes filler words, fixes mistakes and adapts tone for messages, emails or formal writing, while still sounding like you. You can also speak in one language and instantly get text in another. With support for up to 100 languages, communication across countries feels smooth and natural.

slides.title: Essential Apps
slides.body: Essential Apps let you create small, personal tools using simple language. Instead of downloading apps, you shape what you need around your day. These tools live directly on your home screen, stay active, and respond when you need them. They feel less like apps you open and more like tools that are already there, ready to use.

slides.title: A marketplace for personal tools
slides.body: Playground is where Essential Apps live, travel and grow. Browse tools made by the community, download what fits your life or share what you’ve built with others. Alongside Essential Apps, Playground is also home to Glyph Toys, camera presets and EQ profiles. Personal ideas become shared creations, without app stores or barriers.

slides.title: Essential Apps Builder
slides.body: The Essential Apps Builder is how your ideas take form. Describe what you want in plain language and the builder turns it into a working tool. No coding. No setup. You can refine it over time, personalise it with your own visuals and keep it exactly how you like. When you’re ready, share it through Playground or keep it just for yourself.

slides.title: Camera Presets
slides.body: Camera Presets let you discover and share different ways of seeing. Browse presets created by the community and download them directly to your Nothing camera, or upload your own presets you’ve already made to share with others. Each preset reflects a personal shooting style, from colour and contrast to mood and tone, turning photography into something personal, expressive and easy to explore together.

slides.title: Ultra-sharp 1.5K resolution
slides.body: 1.5K high-resolution flexible AMOLED display with 13.6% more pixels* makes text, photos, and videos exceptionally crisp. *Compared to Phone (3a) Pro.

slides.title: Stunning in any light
slides.body: The 4,500-nit ultra-bright display is 50% brighter, with 23% better sunlight visibility. 10-bit colour delivers 1.07 billion vivid tones*. *Compared to Phone (3a) Pro.

slides.title: Smart & smooth at 120 Hz
slides.body: The adaptive refresh rate dynamically shifts between 30 Hz to 120 Hz for fluid motion while saving power.

slides.title: Eye comfort
slides.body: Our phones use advanced display tech that intelligently reduces flicker – the hidden culprit behind night-time eye strain. The result? Comfortable viewing in any lighting, at any brightness.

slides.title: More power
slides.body: Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 features an 8-core CPU and enhanced graphics, paired with the Qualcomm AI Engine and faster UFS 3.1 to make multitasking, AI workloads, and gaming effortless.

slides.title: Geared to game
slides.body: Enjoy ultra-smooth, lag-free 120 FPS gameplay with 2,500 Hz instant touch sampling rate, powered by a 4600 mm² vapour cooling system for ultra-responsive, longer, and more stable sessions. The X-axis linear motor adds responsive haptic feedback that brings your games to life.⁴

slides.title: Play all day
slides.body: Charge in minutes, last for days with a 5,080* mAh battery. 21 hours of YouTube. 26 hours of Instagram scrolling. 26 hours of listening to music. 47 hours of voice calls. Maintain over 90% maximum capacity after 1,200 charging cycles. 50W Fast Charge. A day's power in under 30 mins⁵. *5,400 mAh (India only)

slides.title: Crafted with precision
slides.body: Advanced factories combined with professional automated production and assembly techniques ensure meticulous craftsmanship and fine detail. A lower carbon footprint of 51.13 kg CO₂e, surpassing all previous Nothing devices. Phone (4a) also incorporates 30 components that contain recycled materials, accounting for 4.05% of the total weight. Recycled materials - 30% recycled plastic is used for 9 plastic parts. - 100% recycled aluminium is used for 3 parts. - 100% recycled tin is used in 5 circuit boards. - 80% recycled steel is used for 15 steel parts. Packaging - 100% plastic-free. Manufacturing - 100% renewable energy for the final assembly process.
